notes:
Lectures Dark is now Lecture Pass: every lecture is a ticket.
• Today and Week show your lectures as passes, with a live countdown, the room on the stub, and a stub that tears off when the lecture ends.
• Flip a pass to add to-dos and notes for that subject, and stamp it when you attend.
• Passport tab: a page for each subject with its hours and your stamps. Explore tab: search subjects, rooms and lecturers, see your free time, and compare with another group.
• Arabic: choose العربية in Settings → Language · اللغة.
• A new home-screen widget in three sizes.
Your group and settings stay as they are.
